shots.alt: Markets screen showing commodity browser, universe spot chart, logistics metrics, best quotes, producers, and consumers
shots.label: Layout
shots.title: Markets split view
shots.text: Markets pairs the commodity browser with a detail column for spot history, logistics, quotes, producers, and consumers.

shots.alt: Markets commodity browser showing spot price, stock depth, low ask, high bid, and spread columns
shots.label: Browser
shots.title: Commodity browser
shots.text: Rows compare spot price, stock depth, best local ask, best local bid, and spread for every physical good.

shots.alt: Markets commodity category tabs with counts for commodities, food, raw, parts, fuel, advanced, luxury, and upgrades
shots.label: Tabs
shots.title: Commodity category tabs
shots.text: Category tabs narrow the list to food, raw goods, parts, fuel, advanced goods, luxury goods, or upgrade modules.

shots.alt: Markets universe spot chart for a selected commodity
shots.label: Spot
shots.title: Universe spot chart
shots.text: The detail column charts universe-wide spot history for the selected good with its base price as the reference line.

shots.alt: Markets spot and logistics KPI panels showing price, base, stock health, producers, consumers, net flow, and runway
shots.label: Signals
shots.title: Spot and logistics signals
shots.text: Spot explains price, base, stock health, and spread while Logistics compares active markets, production, consumption, and runway.

shots.alt: Markets best asks and best bids panels listing station names, prices, stock, and target demand
shots.label: Quotes
shots.title: Best asks and best bids
shots.text: The quote panels show where the cheapest supply and strongest demand are sitting right now.

shots.alt: Markets top producers and top consumers panels with station names and per tick rates
shots.label: Flows
shots.title: Top producers and consumers
shots.text: Producer and consumer lists identify which stations create or absorb the selected good fastest.
